style_rules: Use the approved reference image as the primary visual reference.
Re-render the entire infographic as one unified image; do not paste text on top of the reference.
Preserve the approved information hierarchy: header, date card, 4 KPI cards, chart, overview panel, detail table, footer.
Keep a bright premium corporate office/city-view aesthetic with navy, blue, green and gold accents.
Optimize for mobile first while remaining sharp on desktop.
All Vietnamese names, dates, times, durations, statuses and KPI values must come from the validated request only.
Do not invent attendance values or employee names.
The generated image is test-only until the visual QA gate confirms every displayed value.
